title: 海上風機安裝船作業
summary: 用模型比較浮力、支承、吊運和天候窗口，將工程驗證與真實海上作業分開。 在風機安裝船模型與排程室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Compare buoyancy, support, lifting and weather windows in models, separately from offshore operations. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Wind-installation vessel model/schedule studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 載重狀態與排水量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Load state and displacement: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 載重狀態與排水量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Load state and displacement and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「海上風機安裝船作業」的「載重狀態與排水量」中，靜水浮力等於排開水的重量；平衡時排水質量等於總質量。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：用模型比較浮力、支承、吊運和天候窗口，將工程驗證與真實海上作業分開。
steps.instructionEn: Within Wind-turbine installation-vessel operations, Load state and displacement examines this mechanism: Static buoyancy equals displaced-water weight; equilibrium displacement mass equals total mass. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Compare buoyancy, support, lifting and weather windows in models, separately from offshore operations.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：ρ=1025 kg/m³，排水體積 V=18 m³。關係式 M=ρV；含單位換算算式 1025*18 = 18450 kg。適用條件：只代表靜水質量平衡，未驗證傾覆、波浪與艙口進水。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: Density 1025 kg/m³ and displaced volume 18 m³. Relation M=ρV; expression including unit conversion 1025*18 = 18450 kg. Applicability: Static mass balance only; capsize, waves and downflooding remain unverified.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：不同密度下仍假設相同載重和相同吃水，會讓質量與體積帳互相矛盾。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Assuming equal load and equal draft at different densities makes mass and volume accounting inconsistent. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「載重狀態與排水量」，分別以體積積分與質量清單重算，對照兩者差額。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Load state and displacement, Recalculate from volume integration and a mass inventory, then compare their difference. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「海上風機安裝船作業」的「載重狀態與排水量：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海上能源：岸電交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Load state and displacement: Mechanism and observation” in “Wind-turbine installation-vessel operations”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
